# Investor banker markedet - sådan justerer han porteføljen lige nu

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-10-28  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish Euroinvestor Millionærklubben episode recorded on results day. Host Michael Friis Jørgensen (H.C. Andersen Capital) says he has moved about 20% back into AI and energy infrastructure because he thinks the sell-off went too far. He is cautious about it, 'with the handbrake on', ahead of the Alphabet and Microsoft results and a Fed meeting where no rate change is expected. Guest Michael Vest Hypold (Regulær Invest Nordiske Aktier) says geopolitics makes it impossible to pick 2027's winning theme, so he has spread the portfolio across 40 stocks in several themes. He has recently added ABB and Instalco and is hunting for bargains during the reporting season.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 INSTAL — Instalco | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Guest Hypold added to his position, buying at ~40.5; prefers it to Installatørgruppen.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: Swedish industrial order intake is improving, Instalco has a good industry position and stronger market conditions, organic growth is turning positive after a negative spell, and profitability gains are still to come. Together these support earnings growth next year.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Swedish industrial demand weakens again
- if organic growth stays negative
- if margin improvement fails to materialise

> *"Vi har taget lidt ekstra Instalco"*

---

### 🟢 ABB — ABB | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Guest Hypold bought more ABB, saying it had fallen too far to ~820.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: a quality electrification and growth-pocket name that became a bargain after AI/data-centre suppliers sold off 10-15%. It fits the fund's approach of buying on dips when the investment case is unchanged.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the data-centre/electrification capex cycle turns
- if the investment case changes fundamentally

> *"Jamen det seneste, vi gjorde, det var ABB. som vi egentlig følte, at den var kommet for langt ned på det her 820-niveau."*

---

### 🟢 VWS — Vestas | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host Friis bought extra Vestas ahead of results as part of the energy side of AI infrastructure.

#### Reasoning

Host view: order-book worries are explained by orders pulled forward before the Q2 tax rebate. He is rotating about 20% into energy-linked AI infrastructure after an oversold phase, though cautiously.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the order book weakens beyond the pull-forward effect
- if the AI-infrastructure rebound fades

> *"jeg har købt lidt ekstra Vestas hen mod regnskabet"*

---

### 🟢 SU — Schneider Electric | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host added it to his Millionærklubben portfolio in his rotation into AI infrastructure.

#### Reasoning

Host view: AI infrastructure was oversold, and catalysts (strong memory results, a Fed hold, big-tech results) point to a rebound. He prefers the energy and electrification side, with the handbrake on.

#### Sell Triggers

- if hyperscaler results disappoint or capex is cut

---

### 🟢 VRT — Vertiv Holdings | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host added it to his Millionærklubben portfolio in his rotation into AI infrastructure.

#### Reasoning

Host view: data-centre power and cooling exposure that should benefit if the oversold AI-infrastructure trade recovers on strong earnings evidence.

#### Sell Triggers

- if hyperscaler capex guidance is cut
- if data-centre utilisation and pricing fall

---

### 🟢 SOLAR-B — Solar | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest holds a 3.5% weight and expects an earnings lift in 2027. Host is starting to add a little.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: 2026 is a transition year (Norwegian acquisition, automated warehouse in Sweden), with earnings lifting in 2027. Host view: higher German industrial demand helps. Both note it is structurally challenged as a price-driven volume distributor that can be bypassed.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the 2027 earnings lift fails to appear
- if price competition intensifies
- if large customers bypass distributors

> *"Vi har faktisk en 3,5% vægt i portføljen på Solar."*

---

### 🟡 MSFT — Microsoft | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host owns it in his core portfolio and is optimistic ahead of tonight's results; watching Azure growth.

#### Reasoning

Host view: strong demand and pricing data from the AI supply chain suggest strong results and a likely clearing event for AI infrastructure. Options positioning leans toward a positive reaction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Azure growth disappoints
- if capex rises without visible returns

> *"Men jeg ejer selvfølgelig Microsoft, men dem ligger jeg jo altid med"*

---

### 🟠 GOOGL — Alphabet | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host is positive on tonight's results (cloud plus ads) but does not own it.

#### Reasoning

Host view: the data-centre business and the ad business are both doing well in a healthy economy, so he expects strong results and a positive reaction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if cloud growth or capex guidance disappoints

---

### 🔴 NOKIA — Nokia | **SELL** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest sold out because he could no longer justify the valuation after the strong run.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: it contributed to performance but became too expensive. There is also a competitive threat from SpaceX in telecom networks.

> *"så kunne vi simpelthen ikke regne den hjem længere"*

---

### 🟡 NKT — NKT | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest holds it for electrification exposure at what he sees as a reasonable price.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: part of the electrification growth-pocket theme, priced reasonably.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the electrification theme stalls

---

### 🟡 JYSK — Jyske Bank | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest holds it as a bank winning market share.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: banks look fairly priced overall, so he wants banks undergoing value-creating change; Jyske is gaining share from recent changes in the sector.

#### Sell Triggers

- if market-share gains reverse

---

### 🟡 SYDB — AL Sydbank | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest holds it for merger synergies.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: value-creating change from the merger synergies still to be realised.

#### Sell Triggers

- if merger synergies are not realised

---

### 🟡 AMBEA — Ambea | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest holds it as a defensive inflation hedge.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: inflation-indexed contracts let it pass rising costs on to customers.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the defensive rotation unwinds sharply

---

### 🟡 SECU-B — Securitas | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest added it during the defensive shift and holds it as an inflation hedge.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: an inflation-indexed contract model and defensive exposure, part of a balanced, multi-theme portfolio.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the defensive rotation unwinds

---

### 🟡 ALFA — Alfa Laval | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest holds it for data-centre cooling and a multi-year shipbuilding backlog.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: growth exposure on more than one leg at a reasonable price.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the backlog shrinks

---

### 🟡 PAAL-B — Per Aarsleff | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Guest holds it for infrastructure exposure.

#### Reasoning

Guest view: infrastructure spending will not slow any time soon, and the price is reasonable.

#### Sell Triggers

- if infrastructure spending slows

---
